description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyId class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package, verifying behaviors such as immutability, equality, exception handling, and string representation.

classes.name: PolicyIdTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PolicyId class behavior, including validation of immutability, equality, exception cases, and core methods.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Tests that PolicyId instances are immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies that PolicyId's equals and hashCode methods work correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: invalidNamespaceThrowsPolicyIdInvalidException
methods.description: Ensure invalid namespace inputs throw PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: invalidNameThrowsPolicyIdInvalidException
methods.description: Ensure invalid name inputs throw PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: dummyIsDummy
methods.description: Tests that the dummy PolicyId is recognized as dummy.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedDummyIsDummy
methods.description: Tests that manually created dummy PolicyIds are recognized as dummy.

methods.name: validPolicyIdIsNoDummy
methods.description: Checks that valid PolicyIds are not marked as dummy.

methods.name: returnsCorrectNamespace
methods.description: Tests that getNamespace() returns the expected namespace.

methods.name: returnsCorrectName
methods.description: Tests that getName() returns the expected name.

methods.name: inNamespaceWithRandomNameHasCorrectNamespace
methods.description: Checks that inNamespaceWithRandomName() creates a PolicyId with the correct namespace.

methods.name: policyIdOfPolicyIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that calling PolicyId.of() with an existing PolicyId returns the same instance.
